# Inkwell

> Inkwell is a free, open-source AI writing assistant for macOS (menu bar, macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows (notification area, Windows 10 and 11). Type a trigger such as ?fix at the end of text in any app and Inkwell replaces it with the AI result in place. No account, no subscription and no Inkwell server.

## What it does
- ?fix fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation
- ?rewrite rewrites text so it reads more clearly
- ?formal rewrites in a polite, professional tone
- ?short makes text shorter
- ?ask answers the question in the text
- ?reply drafts a reply below a received message
- ?en translates to English
- Triggers are editable templates; users can add their own.

## Providers
- Gemini and Groq: free API keys. Multiple keys and fallback models are rotated automatically on rate limits; per-minute and daily limits are told apart (Gemini's daily quota resets at midnight Pacific).
- Claude Code and Codex: use the user's existing Claude or ChatGPT plan through the signed-in CLI. Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly limits and Codex usage limits are recognised; Inkwell shows which limit was hit and when it resets.

## Privacy
- Only the last 64 typed characters are held in memory to detect triggers; nothing is logged.
- Text is sent only to the chosen provider, only when a trigger is typed.
- API keys are stored in the macOS Keychain, or encrypted with Windows DPAPI for the user's account. Password fields are never read.
- The only other network request is a check of the GitHub repository's latest release, for update notices.

## Install
- macOS, Homebrew: brew install --cask devrahulbanjara/inkwell/inkwell
- macOS, DMG: https://github.com/devrahulbanjara/inkwell/releases/latest/download/Inkwell.dmg
- Windows installer (per-user, no admin): https://github.com/devrahulbanjara/inkwell/releases/latest/download/Inkwell-Setup.exe
- Both apps update themselves in one click when a new release is out.
